name: Access Point
author: Niall Ó Cléirigh
description: Shows which access point of a multi-access-point Wi-Fi network you're connected to, and lets you name and switch between them.

barWidget.description: The name of the access point you're on, with a list of every access point broadcasting the network. Hidden on networks with a single access point.

schema.label: Pin to network (SSID)
schema.description: Leave empty to follow the connected network. The widget then only appears on networks with more than one access point.

schema.label: Show the access point's name in the bar
